{{Quote|&hellip;''Junkfort Station'', Chewie! Lotta ships get illegal equipment and modifications here&hellip;|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
The '''Junkfort system''', known as the '''Kossimur system''' [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. It contained the notable [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]]. At one point a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] eventually became a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] as well as the territorial holdings of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], it fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Junkfort Station was visited by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], in search of one of the rare artifacts known as [[power gem]]s. An [[Raskar's agent|agent]] of the ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] ultimately pointed the pair to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antipose]], where a power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] was indeed being kept, and Solo and Chewbacca subsequently departed the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station. Nearly thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Attack on Junkfort Station|captured]] Junkfort Station as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The Junkfort [[Star system/Legends|system]] was a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that connected it to the [[Nimat system/Legends|Nimat]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Marleyvane system/Legends|Marleyvane systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] also linked the system to the [[Dernatine system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> while the [[Cadma Conduit]] connected it to the [[Dagelin Minor system/Legends|Dagelin Minor]] and [[Simbarc system/Legends|Simbarc systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]]. The Junkfort system contained<ref name="EAOC" /> at least two [[Color/Legends|brown]] astronomical objects as well as the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

==History==
===Before the Clone Wars===
[[File:Fourth_Pius_Dea_Crusade.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Galactic Republic launched an attack toward the Kossimur system during the Fourth Pius Dea Crusade.]]
Between [[25,102 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and approximately [[11,000 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the Junkfort system was known as the Kossimur system. The [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] incorporated the system into [[Xim's empire|his empire]] at some point between 25,102 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]] and [[Xim Wars|moved]] his forces from the [[Dennogra system/Legends|Tialvai system]] along a hyperlane connecting it to the Kossimur and subsequently along the routes to the Dernatine and [[Tammar system/Legends|Lelrais systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the Junkfort system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[11,920 BBY]], the [[Pius Dea]]&ndash;controlled Republic launched an attack from the [[Ord Zat]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|outpost]] toward the system as part of the the [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade|Fourth Crusade]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Between [[1004 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the Junkfort system was located in space controlled by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], it also constituted a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region.<ref name="TEA" /> The system no longer fell within the borders of Hutt Space proper<ref name="EGTW" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], although it was still situated inside<ref name="TEA" /> the Hutt sphere of influence.<ref name="EGTW" />

===End of the Republic===
[[File:SeparatistCouncilRelocation-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Separatist Council traveled through the Junkfort system while relocating from Belderone to Utapau.]]
The [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] of the Republic was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the vicinity of the Junkfort system during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Junkfort system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

Near the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the war in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who had been tasked with the protection of the Confederacy's [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], was forced to evacuate it from<ref name="TEA" /> the planet [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]],<ref name="Labyrinth">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Belderone sector/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC Belderone">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Belderone system/Legends|Belderone system]]</ref> Traveling along the Triellus Trade Route toward the<ref name="TEA" /> [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]]<ref name="EAOC Utapau">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]]</ref> world of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] where the council was to be relocated, the Confederate forces passed through the Junkfort system.<ref name="TEA" /> The system had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] subsequently visited Junkfort Station at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] on a mission for a Hutt employer.<ref name="TEA" />

===Search for a power gem===
{{Quote|Your little drinking buddy thinks he ''saw'' one on this ''rimworld'' we're headed for&hellip;?|Han Solo, to Chewbacca on a power gem|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:JunkfortStationFalconApproach-ThePowerGemEpicCollection.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' approaches Junkfort Station.]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]], therefore placing the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Solo was tasked by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] with finding and obtaining a [[power gem]],<ref name="PowerGem" /> a rare artifact composed of a<ref name="CSWE power">{{CSWECite|III|40|power gem}}</ref> [[Meteorite/Legends|meteoritic]]<ref name="DoomMission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]],<ref name="CSWE power" /> in order to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] combat the new<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="SSDDatabank">{{DB|starship|superstardestroyer|Super Star Destroyer}}</ref> Intending to begin the search for the legendary gems in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld, Solo and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], traveled in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], from the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance base]] on the<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to Junkfort Station.<ref name="PowerGem" />

After boarding the space station, the pair questioned various [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in a local [[Junkfort Station cantina|cantina]] on any leads on power [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]]. Ultimately, an [[Raskar's agent|agent]] of the ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] pointed Chewbacca to the<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]<ref name="TEA Antipose">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]]</ref> planet<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Antipose]],<ref name="UnstatedCanon">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref> where Raskar hosted lucrative [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions with the gem as their highly sought-after prize. Subsequently, Solo and Chewbacca departed Junkfort Station for Antipose.<ref name="PowerGem" /> At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, members of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Attack on Junkfort Station|captured]] Junkfort Station. The station subsequently remained under the invaders' control until at least 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The Junkfort system's Junkfort Station was a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was frequently visited by starships in order to receive illegal ship modifications and equipment.<ref name="PowerGem" /> In 0 ABY,<ref name="0 ABY" /> the space station's [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was frequented by [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking patrons of various species.<ref name="PowerGem" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Junkfort system numbered between one and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The area of space in which Junkfort Station was situated first appeared in "[[The Power Gem]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Archie Goodwin]], penciled by [[Al Williamson]], and published between [[July 26]] and [[October 3]], [[1982]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], named the [[Star/Legends|star]] system and placed it in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
